title: Design System: Astha Prajapati — Career Instrument

panel-500.note: Reserve token — defined in :root, unreferenced by components.

display.purpose: Big Shoulders Display Variable, uppercase only, always tracked (0.04–0.4em). Casing lettering: headlines, nameplate, tick labels, stamps. Never running text.

body.purpose: Barlow for paragraphs and fact values. Tabular lining numerals site-wide (tnum/lnum) so dates align like a logbook. Never uppercase.

label.purpose: Barlow uppercase, 0.58–0.72rem, tracking 0.04–0.1em. Row keys, chips, provenance lines, location stamps.

shadows.name: bezel-casing
shadows.purpose: The gauge bezel: ambient drop plus lit top edge and dark under-curve.

shadows.name: groove-recess
shadows.purpose: Channel carved between casing and glass; inset only.

shadows.name: nameplate-proud
shadows.purpose: Brass plate sitting slightly proud of the panel.

shadows.name: lamp-bulb-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm glow around indicator-lamp bulbs; light is the shadow.

shadows.name: needle-redline-glow
shadows.purpose: Needle heats up in the final redline zone.

shadows.name: connect-disc
shadows.purpose: Red pilot-lamp button: glow outside, highlight and shade inside.

shadows.name: lamp-well
shadows.purpose: Drilled socket that receives each bulb.

motion.name: needle-spring
motion.value: critically damped spring, stiffness 60, damping 12, rAF-simulated toward scroll-clocked target (src/lib/motion.ts useDampedValue)
motion.purpose: Mechanical needle inertia: the needle lags and settles instead of snapping to scroll position. Bypassed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State responses: CTA color/border transitions, lamp bulb scale, disc scale.

motion.name: duration-wash
motion.purpose: Opacity washes: redline heat on dial face and viewport.

motion.name: duration-crossfade
motion.purpose: Chapter activation: left rule and year-index color crossfade.

motion.name: cue-pulse
motion.purpose: 'scroll to advance the needle' affordance; killed by the reduced-motion override.

motion.name: glass-sweep
motion.purpose: Light sweep across the gauge glass, position-driven by scroll progress (state, not animation).

motion.name: reduced-motion-kill
motion.purpose: Global fallback; the needle spring is additionally bypassed in JS.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Skill banks go two-column; Connect disc grows to 112px.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Scrollytelling rail: sticky h-screen gauge column beside full-height chapter panels; mobile top bar dissolves.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Scroll cue appears beneath the nameplate.

components.name: Gauge Dial
components.description: Signature instrument: brushed-steel bezel, recessed groove, enamel face with 250° arc, per-zone colored segments, ticks, and a spring-lagged red needle. Static snapshot shown; the live needle is scroll-driven.
components.css: .ds-gauge { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1; max-width: 420px; } .ds-gauge-bezel { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: url(/textures/brushed-steel.png); background-size: 160% 160%; background-position: 20% 30%; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.65), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.14), inset 0 -10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); } .ds-gauge-groove { position: absolute; inset: 4.5%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-panel-900); box-shadow: inset 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.75), inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); } .ds-gauge-face { position: absolute; inset: 7%; border-radius: 9999px; overflow: hidden; background: url(/textures/gauge-enamel-face.png) center / cover; filter: brightness(0.97) saturate(0.9); } .ds-gauge-face svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-gauge-track { fill: none; stroke: #3a352c; stroke-opacity: 0.55; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-gauge-seg { fill: none; stroke: #e2402c; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-gauge-tick { stroke: #5b5548; stroke-opacity: 0.55; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-gauge-tick-major { stroke: #5b5548; stroke-opacity: 0.55; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-gauge-year { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; fill: #3d372c; text-anchor: middle; dominant-baseline: middle; } .ds-gauge-needle line { stroke: var(--color-needle); stroke-width: 4; stroke-linecap: round; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(226,64,44,0.85)); } .ds-gauge-needle circle { fill: var(--color-panel-800); stroke: var(--color-needle); stroke-width: 2.5; } .ds-gauge-spec { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 22%, rgba(255,255,255,0.16), transparent 55%); pointer-events: none; }

narrative.northStar: Pressure Rising — the career read on an analog pressure gauge
narrative.overview: This site is an instrument, not a résumé. The whole page is one charcoal-and-steel instrument panel in the idiom of the pressure-vessel industry the subject now leads: a calibrated dial face with an ivory enamel finish, a brushed-steel bezel, brass fittings, and a single red needle that sweeps clockwise as the visitor scrolls through her career. Facts are engraved, not printed — type reads like stamped index plates and etched gauge markings, set in a condensed display face at uppercase with wide tracking. The panel is dark, dense at the edges, and quiet; the only things that move are the needle, the light, and the heat. Density follows the instrument metaphor: information is arranged in labeled rows (ROLE / ORG / WHERE / WHEN) like a spec plate on a machine, and everything numeric uses tabular figures so dates align like a logbook. Cinematic atmosphere is always subordinate to scannability — name, title, employer, and dates are visible without motion. Confirmed visual rejections: the generic dark-mode dev-portfolio and the navy-and-headshot executive-bio default.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant instrument (the gauge) persists on screen as a sticky rail while chapters scroll past it.
Color is mechanical: near-black steel grounds, engraved ivory text, brass for fittings and annotations, needle red strictly for the needle/redline system.
Depth is machined, not layered — inset shadows, textures, and light glows instead of generic card elevation.
Everything rectangular is square-cornered; circles are reserved for instrument bodies.
Motion is mechanical: scroll-clocked, spring-lagged, never bouncy or playful.
Facts carry provenance ("via …", "+N more, unlisted on source") like calibration stickers.

rules.name: The One Needle Rule
rules.body: Needle red exists only inside the instrument system — the needle, redline states, the Connect CTA, and state responses (text selection, scrollbar hover). It is never decoration, never a link color, never more than a sliver of any viewport.

rules.name: The Zone Gradient Rule
rules.body: Arc segments step from dark brass to needle red in one fixed order across the five career zones. Never shuffle the ramp, never recolor a zone — the progression is the story of rising pressure.

rules.name: The Steel Ground Rule
rules.body: All large surfaces come from the panel-950→panel-500 steel ramp. No pure black, no pure white, no blue-gray drift.

rules.name: The Engraved Case Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders Display appears uppercase only, always letter-spaced, never as running text. If it reads like a sentence, it's Barlow.

rules.name: The Tabular Record Rule
rules.body: Every numeral on the page is tabular lining (font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1, "lnum" 1 on body). Dates, durations, and year labels align in columns like an instrument log; never disable it.

rules.name: The Centerline Rule
rules.body: The active chapter is whichever panel's center is nearest the viewport centerline; there is no other activation logic. Panels own at least a full viewport height so the centerline always has a clear owner.

rules.name: The Machined Depth Rule
rules.body: A shadow must describe a physical relationship (above, recessed, glowing, lit from top-left). No soft ambient card elevation; if a surface doesn't read as hardware, it gets a seam instead of a shadow.

dos: Do keep the needle red at sliver scale — the needle line, glow, CTA disc, selection highlight. If a red region grows past a few percent of the viewport, it's the redline wash or you're breaking The One Needle Rule.
Do step arc/segment colors through the fixed ramp (#8a6f3a → #a07c3c → #b6924f → #c9622f → #e2402c) in zone order.
Do set all numerals tabular (tnum/lnum) — it's on body; don't override it.
Do uppercase and track every display-size line (Big Shoulders), widening tracking as size shrinks (up to 0.4em for the certification stamp).
Do give rectangular surfaces square corners and 1px Panel Seam borders; reserve circles for instrument bodies; use 3px only on the nameplate.
Do label facts with the ROLE/ORG/WHERE/WHEN key grid and carry provenance ("via …", "+N more, unlisted on source") rather than inventing data.
Do keep every raster's impeccable:prompt tEXt chunk intact when regenerating or cropping assets.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: the needle must snap (no spring), CSS animations/transitions collapse to 0.01ms, and content must remain fully readable with all motion off.
donts: Don't use needle red for links, headings, or decoration outside the instrument system.
Don't introduce soft generic card shadows or large border radii — depth is machined (insets, glows, textures) or it's a seam.
Don't set Big Shoulders Display in lowercase, sentence case, or untracked; don't use it for body copy.
Don't hide name, title, employer, or dates behind motion — chapter content is statically visible; only the instrument animates.
Don't fabricate a headshot, metrics, testimonials, or contact channels; imagery stays atmospheric/industrial, and LinkedIn stays the only CTA.
Don't reorder or recolor the zone ramp, or add a sixth zone without extending the ramp and the tick geometry (50° per zone, 250° total sweep).
Don't drop the cooldown beat or the hero dissolve — removing them makes the redline climax end abruptly and the first frame read as a plain photo header.
